title: Missing 411: national park disappearances tied to UFO sightings and hidden FBI files

plain: A researcher named David Pitus, author of the Missing 411 books about people who vanish in US national parks, is said to have found that the same areas where people go missing are places where people also report seeing UFOs, a link tied to a work called Closer Encounters and to FBI files said to be hidden. The writer Jason Jorjani repeats this from Pitus's work, as a hint that the disappearances and the sightings may be connected.
